stem: A school in Jaipur is building a rectangular courtyard whose length is 6 meters greater than its width. The area, in square meters, of the courtyard is given by \(A(w) = w(w + 6)\), where \(w\) is the width, in meters. If the area of the courtyard is 135 square meters, what is its width, in meters?
verify:
w = symbols('w')
sols = solve(Eq(w*(w + 6), 135), w)
assert sorted(sols) == [-15, 9]
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [s for s in sols if s > 0]
